roadmapPosition: Alpha 7.4B — Baseline locomotion, input and neutral Arcane Bolt

a0-control.purpose: Exact Alpha 7.5 playable neutral Arcane values.

a1-responsive.purpose: Test quicker ordinary firing and earlier visual travel without increasing damage, hitbox or range.
a1-responsive.expectedPlayerResult: A tap reads sooner, repeated neutral shots feel less sticky, and airborne firing obscures movement for less time.
regressionRisks: The 6.8% cadence increase raises unmodified sustained damage unless later threat tuning compensates.
Faster travel reduces the amount of lead required at medium range.
A shorter fire pose may make the cast animation less readable.

approvalRule: A1 cannot replace A0 until input-to-fire captures and casual/expert tests show a clear responsiveness gain without harming cast readability or encounter balance.
